lines.msg: Remote session established from IP 203.0.113.14 (known-good external IP) using MFA token valid and previously issued.
User 'halden-support' (Integrator account) authenticated via MFA and session established.
Session active; no commands executed from this host.
Audit trail: Session initiated from external IP 203.0.113.14 via RDP to CVG-OT-JMP01.
Session terminated normally by remote client.
Session duration: 12 minutes.
No commands logged in session; no activity in PipeView, RTU, or engineering tools.
Session closed. No known access to CVG-SCADA01, CVG-ENG01, or RTUs via this path.
Audit entry written to CVG-OT-JMP01 event log: 'Session from 203.0.113.14 (halden-support) terminated.'
No evidence of configuration change, command execution, or file transfer.
Integrator session not on baseline for access pattern; session was not preceded by a scheduled support window.
Source IP 203.0.113.14 is external and not associated with any known integrator office location.

instructorNote: This inject confirms a cyber-physical threat vector. The CYB must now declare a cyber incident and initiate containment per C2 and C1.
